style: Acoustic chamber art-rock, doo-wop vocal pop, and archaic string-band drive. Harmony: modal drone in D minor with parallel fifths, quartal suspensions, and non-diatonic cluster rubs. Melody: angular folk turns, yodel register flips, and fast bureaucratic recitative patter. Rhythm: additive 7/8 and 5/8 asymmetric meters interlocked with a motorik pulse and silent gaps. Timbre: harpsichord, pump organ, upright bass, banjo, brushed snare, and mono tape bleed. Performance: deadpan bureaucratic solemnity mixed with aggressive communal folk urgency. Production: 1960s dry chamber room capture with analog tape saturation. Operators: compress the 7/8 metric pulse while stretching the vocal melisma; hold the modal D drone fixed while all inner voices migrate; make the banjo behave like a ledger-book calculating machine; force incompatible temporal scales of sixteenth-note patter and slow sustained organ chords to coexist; return to the initial vocal anchor in a severely mutated form.
lyrics:
[Intro: dry acoustic atmosphere, ticking metronome, sparse plucked banjo and harpsichord runs]
[Verse 1: deadpan male vocal duet, close-position harmony, rhythmic patter]
Item one: the presence is filed away.
Item two: the room is entirely empty.
We calculate the non-existence of the floor,
We measure the weight of a missing door.
[Pre-Chorus: yodel register flip, pump organ swells, additive 7/8 rhythm]
Where nothing stands, we write the statute down!
Where no one breathes, we claim the empty town!
[Chorus: massed doo-wop vocal harmony, hocketed consonants, handclaps, pump organ]
Prove the absence! Stamp the void!
Every vacant space is proudly employed!
No body here, no substance found,
We measure the silence underground!
[Verse 2: fast chromatic cabaret patter, upright bass, brushed snare, sudden silent gap]
Recall mold remembers the sound of a wall,
That never was built, that never could fall.
The tax collector audited the vacant space,
And found zero grams of human face.
[Bridge: structural phase shift, 5/8 asymmetric meter, bowed metal percussion]
Flow ghoul dissolves the structural frame,
Leaving only the rate of its Latin name.
Axiom vandal negates the ground,
So floating proves that we are bound.
[Guitar Solo / Harpsichord Interlude: rapid microtonal cluster runs, motorik pulse acceleration]
[Verse 3: spoken bureaucratic recitation, overlapping voices, increasing tension]
Root surgeon replaces the primitive root,
With a mathematical proof of a fruit.
That has never been grown in any soil,
Requiring endless administrative toil.
[Pre-Chorus: yodel register flip, pump organ swells, additive 7/8 rhythm]
Where nothing stands, we write the statute down!
Where no one breathes, we claim the empty town!
[Chorus: massed doo-wop vocal harmony, hocketed consonants, handclaps, pump organ]
Prove the absence! Stamp the void!
Every vacant space is proudly employed!
No body here, no substance found,
We measure the silence underground!
[Breakdown: sudden drop to a single dry banjo, whispered ensemble rhythm, slow tempo]
Lesion wizard deletes the sense of here,
Leaving a geometric map of fear.
Utility demon rewards the missing weight,
As the system calculates its own estate.
[Climax: hyper-drive overload, 7/8 rhythm compression, massed choral shouting, distorted pump organ]
THE VOID IS DENSE! THE VOID IS HEAVY!
WE EXPORT NOTHING TO THE ROYAL NAVY!
[Outro: sudden silent gap, single ticking metronome, deadpan spoken tag]
Item final: the proof is complete.
There is nothing underneath our feet.

caption: An acoustic chamber art-rock and doo-wop track driven by mathematical proofs of absolute absence. Built entirely on additive 7/8 meters, intricate harpsichord runs, hypnotic modal D drones, and deadpan bureaucratic vocal recitations delivered with precision. Features rigorous strict counterpoint, wild yodel flips, and complex structural mutations that systematically calculate emptiness. Every melodic fracture measures the exact weight of void within the machine. Total execution complete.
